text: Steenbarger, on BBY: the volume test is oneil's, not mine. My method reads permission and transition: elder_5d [10, 5, 6, 0, 9], a certain red 0 giving way to 9 (C3, C4), CORRECTION_REENTRY with mp_state STRONG (R8). day_vol is outside my menu, so I cannot rule the C16 objection set aside; I defer that to oneil's method. The words "elder stays at 7 or above" are mine and they are a permission line, not a volume test. Writing day_vol at or above 1.40 into the trigger does not conflict with my read; I would ratify the ticket with it or without it.
